title: Encrypted DNS Session Attempt Planning Work Item
summary: Add deterministic local encrypted DNS session-attempt planning across SVCB, discovery, and provisioning inputs.
planned_changes:
- Add an immutable session-attempt model and source enum.
- Add a planner for RFC 9461 service-binding plans, RFC 9463 discovery plans, and RFC 9464 provisioning plans.
- Preserve protocol, address, port, authentication name, service priority, service metadata, HTTPS metadata, and cleartext fallback eligibility.
- Reject attempts that target classic cleartext DNS port 53.
- Add focused positive, negative, and edge tests plus canonical xrefs.
- Update the encrypted DNS gap ledger to distinguish local planning from live session establishment.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused session planner tests, core SpecTrace validation, generated QUIC requirement coverage triage, and diff hygiene before commit.
out_of_scope: Opening live DoT, DoQ, or DoH sessions.
completion_notes: The DNS package now has a trace-owned scalar session-attempt planner for encrypted DNS inputs.
